article.headline: Ross scores 19 as Marquette knocks off Butler 70-55
article.description: — Chase Ross scored 19 points as Marquette beat Butler 70-55 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Ross scores 19 as Marquette knocks off Butler 70-55
article.story: MILWAUKEE -- — Chase Ross scored 19 points as Marquette beat Butler 70-55 on Saturday. Ross had five assists and three steals for the Golden Eagles (9-15, 4-9 Big East Conference). Adrien Stevens scored 18 points while going 6 of 11 (6 for 9 from 3-point range). Nigel James Jr. shot 6 for 15 and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points. Royce Parham added 12 points and Ben Gold grabbed 10 rebounds. The Bulldogs (13-11, 4-9) were led in scoring by Finley Bizjack, who finished with 23 points. Michael Ajayi added eight points, 19 rebounds — one shy of his season high — and four steals for Butler. Marquette took the lead for good with 1:24 remaining in the first half. The score was 32-28 at halftime, with James racking up 10 points. Marquette extended its lead to 48-34 during the second half, fueled by an 8-0 scoring run. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
